# archestra_share_link (Resource)

Revocable marketplace link exposing an explicit skill/plugin set through a secret-once clone URL. Membership, metadata, expiry and explicit rotation changes replace the link and revoke its predecessor. Expiration remains observed state; out-of-band revocation triggers recreation. Import adopts metadata without recovering its token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Declaring a link deliberately exposes these resources to holders of its URL.
# The URL/token are sensitive and available only on creation. Import adopts
# metadata without recovering secrets. Input changes revoke/replace the link.
resource "archestra_skill" "shared" {
  name            = "shared-example"
  description     = "An explicitly shared skill"
  content         = "Example skill instructions."
  files           = {}
  labels          = []
  environment_ids = []
}
resource "archestra_share_link" "example" {
  name           = "Explicitly shared skill"
  skill_ids      = [archestra_skill.shared.id]
  plugin_ids     = []
  expires_at     = "2040-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  rotation_nonce = "1"
  # Plugin links also require plugin_platform and expires_at; plugin_ids
  # accepts manual or repository package UUIDs. Expired links remain in state.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `plugin_ids` (Set of String) Explicit approved-plugin membership, including an empty set for skill-only links.
- `skill_ids` (Set of String) Explicit skill membership, including an empty set for plugin-only links.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) Canonical UTC expiry with millisecond precision; required for plugin links.
- `name` (String) Optional link label.
- `plugin_platform` (String) Required target operating-system family when sharing plugins.
- `rotation_nonce` (String) Change this value to revoke the old link and create a replacement secret.

### Read-Only

- `clone_url` (String, Sensitive) Secret-once Git clone URL containing the raw token.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `created_by_user_id` (String) Creating user or service-account actor.
- `id` (String) Share-link UUID.
- `last_used_at` (String) Last observed anonymous link use.
- `marketplace_name` (String) Marketplace name frozen at link creation.
- `organization_id` (String) Owning organization UUID.
- `plugin_client_type` (String) Observed client format shared by all attached plugins.
- `plugins` (String) Observed plugin summaries as JSON.
- `raw_token` (String, Sensitive) Secret returned once on creation and preserved through reads.
- `revoked_at` (String) Observed revocation timestamp.
- `skills` (String) Observed skill summaries as JSON.
- `status` (String) Observed active, expired or revoked lifecycle state.
- `token_start` (String) Display prefix of the link token.
- `updated_at` (String) Last metadata timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import archestra_share_link.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
